content: Root cause: The bug was caused by an incorrect calculation of the pattern length in the `parse_string` function, where `strlen(s)` was used instead of `strnlen(s, XT_STRING_MAX_PATTERN_SIZE)`. This led to the potential for incorrect pattern lengths being assigned, especially when the input string was longer than the maximum allowed size, which could result in buffer overflows or incorrect behavior in string matching. Additionally, the handling of the algorithm name length was also incorrect, as it did not account for the null terminator, leading to potential issues when the algorithm name was exactly the maximum allowed size.
